name: Partial Composite Storage
definition: A storage format for partial composites that reduces memory and communication overhead by storing only essential data: 4 floating point values (RGBA) and 2 integers (Zs, Ze) instead of all samples.
summary: Partial Composite Storage compresses volume rendering data by replacing consecutive ray samples with a fixed 24-byte structure of accumulated color, opacity, and depth bounds, reducing memory and communication overhead.
